t: What Road Pavement Failure Database Is All About
title: What Road Pavement Failure Database Is All About
description: Pavement fails by load and water: alligator cracking (fatigue), rutting (weak asphalt or base), potholes (freeze-thaw + traffic), faulting (slab curl). The AASHTO road test (1950s) still underlies design; ESALs (equivalent single axle loads) count the damage — one overloaded truck equals thousands of cars. Drainage is half of pavement engineering. Fix the base, not just the surface. This database is the complete pavement failure: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
